                            (pullback.fst (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map i)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map i)) ≫
                              pullback.fst g (𝒰.map i))
                            ⋯,
                        isLimit := this }).inv ≫
                  pullback.map (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map i) ≫ 𝒰.map i) g ((𝒰.pullbackCover f).map i ≫ f) g
                    (𝟙 (pullback f (𝒰.map i))) (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z) ⋯ ⋯))
          i).J) :
  (openCoverOfBase' 𝒰 f g).map x =
    (pullbackSymmetry (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst))).hom ≫
      (limit.isoLimitCone
            {
              cone :=
                PullbackCone.mk (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)))
                  (pullback.fst (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)) ≫
                    pullback.fst g (𝒰.map x.fst))
                  ⋯,
              isLimit :=
                bigSquareIsPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)))
                  (pullback.fst g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)) (𝒰.map x.fst)
                  (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)))
                  (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) g ⋯ ⋯ (PullbackCone.isLimitOfFlip (pullbackIsPullback g (𝒰.map x.fst)))
                  (PullbackCone.isLimitOfFlip
                    (pullbackIsPullback (pullback.snd g (𝒰.map x.fst)) (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst)))) }).inv ≫
        pullback.map (pullback.snd f (𝒰.map x.fst) ≫ 𝒰.map x.fst) g (pullback.fst f (𝒰.map x.fst) ≫ f) g
            (𝟙 (pullback f (𝒰.map x.fst))) (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z) ⋯ ⋯ ≫
          pullback.map (pullback.fst f (𝒰.map x.fst) ≫ f) g f g (pullback.fst f (𝒰.map x.fst)) (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z) ⋯ ⋯

AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.openCo.comment:
Given an open cover `{ Zᵢ }` of `Z`, then `X ×[Z] Y` is covered by `Xᵢ ×[Zᵢ] Yᵢ`, where
`Xᵢ = X ×[Z] Zᵢ` and `Yᵢ = Y ×[Z] Zᵢ` is the preimage of `Zᵢ` in `X` and `Y`.

          ∃ 𝒰',
            ∃ (x_1 : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J) (j : (𝒰' i).J), IsAffine ((𝒰' i).obj j)),

AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.affine_openCover_tfae.{u} {X Y : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

      ∃ 𝒰,
        ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)), ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), CompactSpace ↑↑(pullback f (𝒰.map i)).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∀ (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover) [inst : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)] (i : 𝒰.J),
        CompactSpace ↑↑(pullback f (𝒰.map i)).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∀ {U : Scheme} (g : U ⟶ Y) [inst : IsAffine U] [inst : IsOpenImmersion g],
        CompactSpace ↑↑(pullback f g).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∃ ι U,
        ∃ (_ : iSup U = ⊤) (_ : ∀ (i : ι), IsAffineOpen (U i)),
          ∀ (i : ι), CompactSpace ↑(⇑f.val.base ⁻¹' (U i).carrier)].TFAE

AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiSeparated.affine_openCover_TFAE.{u} {X Y : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
  [QuasiSeparated f,
      ∃ 𝒰,
        ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)),
          ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), QuasiSeparatedSpace ↑↑(pullback f (𝒰.map i)).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∀ (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover) [inst : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)] (i : 𝒰.J),
        QuasiSeparatedSpace ↑↑(pullback f (𝒰.map i)).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∀ {U : Scheme} (g : U ⟶ Y) [inst : IsAffine U] [inst : IsOpenImmersion g],
        QuasiSeparatedSpace ↑↑(pullback f g).toPresheafedSpace,
      ∃ 𝒰,
        ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)),
          ∃ 𝒰',
            ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : 𝒰.J) (j : (𝒰' i).J), IsAffine ((𝒰' i).obj j)),
              ∀ (i : 𝒰.J) (j k : (𝒰' i).J),
                CompactSpace ↑↑(pullback ((𝒰' i).map j) ((𝒰' i).map k)).toPresheafedSpace].TFAE

AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zariskiPretopol.fullDefinition: def zariskiPretopology : Pretopology (Scheme.{u}) where   coverings Y S := ∃ (U : OpenCover.{u} Y), S = Presieve.ofArrows U.obj U.map   has_isos Y X f _ := ⟨openCoverOfIsIso f, (Presieve.ofArrows_pUnit _).symm⟩   pullbacks := by     rintro Y X f _ ⟨U, rfl⟩     exact ⟨U.pullbackCover' f, (Presieve.ofArrows_pullback _ _ _).symm⟩   transitive := by     rintro X _ T ⟨U, rfl⟩ H     choose V hV using H     use U.bind (fun j => V (U.map j) ⟨j⟩)     simpa only [OpenCover.bind, ← hV] using Presieve.ofArrows_bind U.obj U.map _       (fun _ f H => (V f H).obj) (fun _ f H => (V f H).map)
